title: Revise in structured passes

stage.name: Revision
stage.description: The draft is reworked, pass by pass, into something stronger.

intro: Making it better, one pass at a time.

options: Reading the draft several times, focusing on one thing each time
Asking someone else to rewrite it
questions.why: Focusing on one thing at a time makes a big job manageable.

questions.prompt: Put the passes in their usual order.
questions.why: Start big. There's no point polishing a sentence in a chapter you might cut.

questions.prompt: It's usually best to fix spelling before checking whether the story works.
questions.why: Fix the structure first. Spelling comes last.

questions.prompt: Couples revise too, after disagreements. What helps repair?
options: Taking a break when emotions run high, then coming back to talk calmly
Insisting on finishing the fight right away
questions.why: When feelings flood in, a short pause helps both people come back able to listen.

talk: What helps you make up after a disagreement?
